description:
Reads one bounded item template page, including archived templates.
Use when: showing item details or reviewing a catalog with explicit keyset pagination.
Not for: automatically scanning the whole catalog or combining pages from different revisions.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {revision,definitions,nextAfterKey,total,limits,serverTime}. Retain the first revision for later pages; null cursor ends the list.
Errors: 409 REVISION_CONFLICT or an uncertain response: use horizon_get_items and reconcile intent, never silently substitute a new revision and repeat. 404 ITEM_NOT_FOUND means this instance no longer exists. 422 ITEM_PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED/ITEM_PROPERTY_LIMIT_REACHED rejects the entire adjustment. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

afterKey.description: Previous nextAfterKey, or omit for the first page

catalogRevision.description: First page revision, retained unchanged on later pages; conflict requires restarting the catalog read

limit.description: Explicit page size, default 50; never automatically fetch all pages

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken sent only as Authorization Bearer

userId.description: Signed-in player UUID matching the session

name: horizon_get_item_catalog
title: Get Item Catalog Page
